Messages.Author: Charles Richard Robb
Messages.Body:
Chris Rhodes (rhodesc@medicine) wrote:

: Hey. I've got a few questions here that came up the last time the
: group I play with went at it:

: 1)If a Giants Blood gets Sudden Reversal'd can another GB be played
: later in the game?
No. Only one may be played whether successful or not.

: 2)If range is determined to be ranged in a round, and then I play a
: Blur with superior celerity, does the range stay at long for all
: 3 strikes, so I could essentially throw 3 sewer lids?
Yes. Once range is established it stays that way until a press or new combat.
I never understood why a press would start it over at close...

: 3)How does the superior Cloak the Gathering work? The text on the
: card reads as follows:

: Only usable by a vampire other than an acting minion
: you control to give that minion +1 stealth. Does not
: tap the playing vampire.

: So, do you use it to give someone else's minion +1 stealth, or
: does it give a different minion you control +1 stealth?
You may use it by another vamp to give a vamp +1 stealth. If you had 6 vamps
with sup. obf. you could play 1 on the acting minion and have the other 5 play
one for the acting minion for total +6 stealth. Only one can be played by each
minion for a given action, but you could play as many as you had minions.

Messages.Author: Martin Filion
Messages.Body:
Charles Richard Robb (cr...@Ra.MsState.Edu) wrote:
> Chris Rhodes (rhodesc@medicine) wrote:

> : Hey. I've got a few questions here that came up the last time the
> : group I play with went at it:

> : 3)How does the superior Cloak the Gathering work? The text on the
> : card reads as follows:

> : Only usable by a vampire other than an acting minion
> : you control to give that minion +1 stealth. Does not
> : tap the playing vampire.

> : So, do you use it to give someone else's minion +1 stealth, or
> : does it give a different minion you control +1 stealth?

Since you can't use action modifiers when it's not your turn, you must
give the +1 stealth to a minion that is actually doing the action. You
can't give it to some minion you control saying that he will use it later.

Martin Filion
Montreal, Qb (Canada)
mord...@gmgate.gamemaster.qc.ca

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
rhodesc@medicine (Chris Rhodes) writes:

>Hey. I've got a few questions here that came up the last time the
>group I play with went at it:

>1)If a Giants Blood gets Sudden Reversal'd can another GB be played
> later in the game?

No (well, actually, it can be played, but has no effect). It's considered
played even if SR'd.

>2)If range is determined to be ranged in a round, and then I play a
> Blur with superior celerity, does the range stay at long for all
> 3 strikes, so I could essentially throw 3 sewer lids?

Yes. There is no additional range determination.

>3)How does the superior Cloak the Gathering work? The text on the
> card reads as follows:

> Only usable by a vampire other than an acting minion
> you control to give that minion +1 stealth. Does not
> tap the playing vampire.

> So, do you use it to give someone else's minion +1 stealth, or
> does it give a different minion you control +1 stealth?

Your own minion. You can't play action mods on another's turn.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cr...@Ra.MsState.Edu (Charles Richard Robb) writes:
>Chris Rhodes (rhodesc@medicine) wrote:
>: Hey. I've got a few questions here that came up the last time the

>: group I play with went at it:
>: 1)If a Giants Blood gets Sudden Reversal'd can another GB be played
>: later in the game?

>No. Only one may be played whether successful or not.

Yes. But only the first would have any effect, and it's effect was cancelled
by SR. (A technical point, to be sure, but you still could burn extra
copy of the card as your master play - instead of waiting to discard it).

>: 3)How does the superior Cloak the Gathering work? The text on the
>: card reads as follows:

>: Only usable by a vampire other than an acting minion
>: you control to give that minion +1 stealth. Does not
>: tap the playing vampire.

>: So, do you use it to give someone else's minion +1 stealth, or
>: does it give a different minion you control +1 stealth?

>You may use it by another vamp to give a vamp +1 stealth. If you had 6 vamps
>with sup. obf. you could play 1 on the acting minion and have the other 5 play
>one for the acting minion for total +6 stealth. Only one can be played by each
>minion for a given action, but you could play as many as you had minions.

And, you may not use it to give someone else's minion +1 stealth
(except, thanks DTR, a Malk taking an action during your turn after
your actions, like that would ever happen), because Action Mods can only
be played during your own turn.
